headline: PNB Gilts appoints Amit Kumar Srivastava as Non-Executive Chairman
hook: Leadership change at state-backed primary dealer
summary: PNB Gilts Ltd has announced the appointment of Amit Kumar Srivastava as a Non-Executive and Non-Independent Director, as well as the Chairman of the company. The appointment is effective from October 9, 2026. PNB Gilts operates as a primary dealer in government securities in India. Retail investors in banking and financial stocks should note changes in board-level leadership for governance tracking.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with no immediate financial impact.
